event.description: Replace all LayerNorm sites with per-coordinate RMSNorm
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 2 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0018, which removed only the final LayerNorm bias and qualified at 3,360 parameters and 99.07%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0019, whose residual LayerNorm bias-group removal scored 0.01%. Hypothesis: learned per-coordinate scales are essential but explicit mean centering and additive shifts are redundant across the pre-normalized residual stack. This is a major normalization substitution, not scalar pruning: all four block normalizers and the final normalizer become RMSNorm with migrated dense scale vectors, removing every learned normalization bias and fixed/learned centering parameter while yielding 1,629 parameters. It is more informative than ScaleNorm because RMSNorm retains the full per-coordinate scaling capacity and changes only centering/bias behavior, the least restrictive operation-level alternative. Causal self-attention, feed-forward paths, token/position representations, autoregressive logits, and generic decoding remain unchanged.
